adaptation: State changes commit immediately; animation only presents the committed result and must cancel on the next intent.
Preserve the existing component identity, focus and native scroll rather than rebuilding a page to animate it.
Held controls compress immediately; release, selection and disclosure use role-specific interruptible motion values. Opacity remains a short eased transition.
Inert local surface snapshots finish visual exits after Radix releases input and scroll ownership; reopening reuses current movement and alpha.
Local image FLIP preserves source-to-stage continuity without document-wide view-transition snapshots. Zoom stays anchored, pointer movement is direct, and only released overscroll settles.
notCopied: Upstream theme CSS, desktop-extracted code, fonts, imagery and spring constants.
The upstream globally shared segmented layoutId, which can connect unrelated instances.
The upstream accumulated drag offset and global view-transition hook; runtime findings and diagnostic prerequisites are documented in motion-adaptation.md.
Blurred per-character text reveal, all-page entrance, scroll interception and a second component system.
implementation: Independent mooncci implementations reuse Radix ownership, existing feedbackMotion (motion/mini), installed motion values and numeric animation, motion.css, RoutePosition and native pointer capture. No npm dependency was added.
